recognize_zh: 10倍低倍下整張抹片布滿藍紫色有核細胞，顯示白血球極度增多（hyperleukocytosis），箭頭處為紅血球成團聚集；低倍只能判斷細胞量與紅血球凝集，細胞型態需高倍確認。
features: Low-power view with markedly increased density of nucleated cells (hyperleukocytosis)
Nucleated cells appear relatively uniform in size at this magnification
Discrete clumps of agglutinated red cells (black arrows)
Magnification insufficient to assess nuclear shape, granules or Auer rods
describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a markedly increased number of nucleated cells, consistent with hyperleukocytosis, with several discrete clumps of agglutinated red cells (arrows). Cytologic detail of the nucleated cells, including nuclear shape, granularity and Auer rods, cannot be evaluated at this magnification. In conjunction with higher-power images showing bilobed hypogranular promyelocytes, findings are consistent with microgranular acute promyelocytic leukemia with hyperleukocytosis and red cell agglutination.

ddx.vs: CML shows a full spectrum of maturing granulocytes with basophilia and myelocyte bulge at higher power rather than a uniform population of abnormal promyelocytes.
Lymphoblasts are smaller with scant agranular cytoplasm and MPO negativity, which requires higher-power and ancillary evaluation.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-agglutination due to thick smear or rouleaux
ddx.vs: Rouleaux form linear stacks in thick areas, whereas true agglutinates are irregular clumps in thin areas of the smear.
